q1_corner_entry_dominant_beams.conclusion: During corner entry, ray_minus_45 dominates steering to anticipate curvature, while ray_0 dominates longitudinal control for turn-in deceleration.

q2_apex_dominant_beams.conclusion: Around the apex, ray_minus_45 and ray_plus_45 dominate steering, while ray_0 governs minimal throttle holding. Sensitivities reach a local minimum due to steering lock saturation.

q3_straight_exit_dominant_beams.conclusion: During straight exit, steering sensitivity rebounds sharply (ray_minus_45 reaches 2.091) as wheels unwind, while ray_0 and diagonal rays guide throttle application.

answers_to_research_questions.q4_steering_sensitivity_change_across_ph: Yes. Steering sensitivity dips at the apex (0.597) due to steering lock saturation, and surges upon straight exit (2.091) as the policy unwinds steering onto the straight.
answers_to_research_questions.q5_braking_sensitivity_before_apex: Yes. Active braking events occur almost exclusively on corner entry and apex approach (9 events on entry, 9 at apex, 0 on straights). Longitudinal ray_0 sensitivity peaks on corner entry (0.101 vs 0.040 on straights).
answers_to_research_questions.q6_throttle_sensitivity_after_apex: Yes. After the apex, longitudinal sensitivity increases from 0.057 at apex to 0.083 at straight exit as the car accelerates out of the turn.
answers_to_research_questions.q7_consistency_across_tracks: Highly consistent. Across all five tracks, diagonal lookahead beams (ray_minus_45 and ray_plus_45) dominate steering guidance, and center forward beam ray_0 governs longitudinal deceleration.
answers_to_research_questions.q8_geometric_differences: Narrow corridors (Track 3) elevate lateral beam sensitivity (+90 deg) relative to open tracks due to wall proximity. Hairpins (Tracks 4 and 5) produce extreme ray_0 braking spikes (>0.025 act/px) not seen on gentle curves.

track_config.title: Track 1: Standard Balanced (Seed 1001, W=70)
track_config.rationale: Nominal width standard circuit with balanced curvature transitions (R_min=83.6 px) and 3 smooth corners. Baseline reference.

track_config.title: Track 2: High-Speed Straights & Sharp Bends (Seed 1002, W=70)
track_config.rationale: Long fast straights (R_mean=1284.4 px) terminating in 4 sharp 90-degree corners (R_min=88.9 px), testing high-speed deceleration.

track_config.title: Track 3: Extreme Narrow Corridor (Seed 1005, W=20)
track_config.rationale: Constricted 20 px corridor (barely wider than car wheelbase) with 3 tight corners, testing severe lateral boundary confinement.

track_config.title: Track 4: Pinched Hairpin (Seed 1003, f=0.50, W=70)
track_config.rationale: High-curvature acute hairpin pinch deformation (R_min=36.2 px) completed in 399 steps, testing deep apex navigation.

track_config.title: Track 5: Severe Acute Pinched Hairpin (Seed 1007, f=0.35, W=70)
track_config.rationale: Tightest completed hairpin benchmark in repository (R_min=43.0 px, pinch factor 0.35), completed in 432 steps.
